Memo No. PSC-R(8)124/2020 Dated ltanagar, the 30th June' 2022
ln continuation to Commission's result Notification No. PSC-R(B)124/2020 Dated
L6lO6l2O22, this is to inform all candidates who have qualified for admission to Finance and
Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer Written Examination (MAIN) under the Department of Finance,
Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh that they have to apply again in the Detailed Application Form
(DAF)for Finance and Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer which will be available on the website of
Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (www.appsg,gg--v.in during the period from
07lO7l2O22 to 2910712022 till 6PM. All the qualified candidate are advised to fill up the Detailed
Application Form( DAF) ONLINE and submit the same ONLINE for admission to the Finance and
Accounts Officer/Treasury Officer Written Examination (MAIN). The e-Admit Card along with the
Time Table of the said Examination will be uploaded on the Commission's Website for the eligible
candidates around 3-4 weeks before the commencement of the Examination.
(Joint Secretarv -Cum -CoE)
